similarity.title: Similarity check
similarity.subtitle: Compare each student's latest submission and review suspicious pairs.
similarity.info: Similarity is measured with token shingles (Jaccard). It flags pairs worth a look — it is not proof of copying. Flagging a pair sets both attempts to flagged, which excludes them from points.

similarity.flaggedNote: Flagged attempts are excluded from points and class averages.
similarity.reviewedNote: Reviewed pairs survive the next check; unreviewed results are replaced.
similarity.notEnough: At least two submissions are needed to compare.
